text: Does the child have any pain in his left hip when you move his leg, and does the pain seem to radiate from the hip to the knee? I will also need to see imaging of both the hip and knee to rule out structural issues. REQUEST IMAGES

text: My main symptom is Pain localized to the left knee. I also have Limping favoring left leg, No fever, No systemic symptoms.

text: Let me examine his hip; does he experience pain or have limited range of motion, specifically with internal rotation or abduction of the left hip? text: Past medical history: No significant past medical or surgical history. Social history: The patient is in the second grade, lives with parents and one younger sibling. No exposure to tobacco or known toxins.
